description:
Requirement: 
 Position: Sencha ExtJS Developer
 Job Location: Ft. Worth, TX 76155
 Duration: 12+ Months Contract with possibility of extension
 Job Description: 
 
 We are looking for a passionate, Senior Level Sencha ExtJS Developer to support our agile team in redesigning our existing pricing applications. The candidate would be responsible for the development, maintenance and support of applications developed for the Pricing business unit. This position offers the opportunity to participate in the entire software development lifecycle and use programming and object-oriented skills, methodologies, and tools to plan, analyze, design, construct and test solutions.  

 

 


 Qualifications: 
 • Must have a degree in Computer Science/Engineering; advanced degree preferred; significant relevant work experience will be considered. 
 • Must have 3+ years of experience in HTML5; Highly prefer experience in Sencha ExtJS 
 • Must have 5+ years of experience in Java Script, CSS and HTML 
 • Must have 3+ years of experience in object-oriented software development and maintenance using Java, Java EE
 • Prefer experience in IBM WAS, Web Development, and UNIX shell scripting. 
 • Prefer experience with Core Spring, Spring Integration, EJB’s, JMS, Web Services 
 • Experience developing and deploying in Eclipse and WebSphere or other application development or server environment 
 • Prefer experience with SQL , Oracle 
 • Prefer experience writing automated test cases using JUnit 
 • Knowledge or hands-on software development experience using UI design patterns is preferred. 
 • Must work well in a team environment 
 • Assist in defining and refining of software development procedures. 
 • Participate in full software development lifecycle. 
 • Excellent oral and written communication skills. 
 • Nice to have experience (in priority order):- Subversion, Rally, Development experience with an agile, iterative, Hudson, Jenkins, architecture centric, test driven development methodology. 
 • Position requires rotational off-hours on-call support
 


 
 Thanks & Regards
Caroline Ignetious
Caroline(dot)i(at)tekwissen(dot)com
734-984-4499
